data.one_liner: Framework-agnostic Dart SDK and reactive state management for the A2UI protocol.
data.what_it_does: Implements the A2UI protocol for Dart, providing protocol message parsing, payload validation, component tree resolution, bidirectional RPC, and reactive surface/data state models built on preact_signals.
use_when: You are building applications that consume or render the A2UI protocol.
You need reactive state management and component resolution for dynamic server-driven UIs.
avoid_when: You are building standard applications without the A2UI protocol requirements.
You need a general-purpose state management solution for standard Flutter widgets.
strengths: Full support for A2UI protocol versions v0.9, v0.9.1, and v1.0.
Reactive state management built on preact_signals.
Built-in basic catalogs with standard validation, formatting, and logic functions.
weaknesses: Highly specialized protocol SDK with limited general-purpose utility.
Legacy v0.8 payloads are not supported.
